turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My dog has started sleeping in our bed and I need to decide what to do about it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Please wait until I've gone through all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could buy him a nice dog bed and put it right next to ours, so he's still close.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or crate train him in the kitchen at night with a blanket over the crate.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could just give up and let him stay in the bed, he's a small dog after all.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or close the bedroom door and let him have the whole living room sofa.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A dog bed beside yours is usually the gentlest change, he stays near you without kicking you at night. The crate works well too but takes more training, while letting him stay or giving him the sofa depends on how much you mind the fur.
